answer_1.quote: ...automated CXR report generation using multimodal language models... We generate the findings and impression sections of a radiology report from CXR images and auxiliary patient data.
answer_1.outputs: Generated findings and impression sections of radiology reports

answer_2.quote: ...we evaluate our model using metrics ... RadGraph-F1 (RG), CheXbert-F1 (CX), CXR-BERT (CB), GREEN (G), BERTScore-F1 (BS), ROUGE-L (R-L), BLEU-4 (B4), and ARN (absence of repeated n-grams).
